about: Needs a Home scene called Good Morning. If yours goes by another name, change it on that step. Its timers reach you with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
name: Getting up when it is dark

steps.about: Runs the scene called Good Morning. Light first is most of the difference in winter.
steps.title: Lights up before your feet are down

steps.about: Said now, while nothing else has had a chance to ask for the morning.
steps.title: The one thing that has to happen today
